Descida de cruzeiro

A descent at a controlled rate while maintaining cruise speed.

Quick answer: A descent at a controlled rate while maintaining cruise speed.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Descida de cruzeiro?

In this glossary, Descida de cruzeiro refers to: A descent at a controlled rate while maintaining cruise speed.

How is Descida de cruzeiro used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Piloto, mantenha a descida de cruzeiro para o nível de voo dois quatro zero."

Why does Descida de cruzeiro matter in aviation?

Descida de cruzeiro matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Descida de cruzeiro?

Descida de cruzeiro is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Descida de cruzeiro belong to?

In this glossary, Descida de cruzeiro is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A descent at a controlled rate while maintaining cruise speed.

Operational example

Pilot, maintain cruise descent to flight level two four zero.

Localized term

Descida de cruzeiro

Localized example

Piloto, mantenha a descida de cruzeiro para o nível de voo dois quatro zero.
